convert_asciidoc_to_docling: convert an AsciiDoc file into a structured DoclingDocument with headings, lists, tables, and images
parse_asciidoc_section_headers: parse AsciiDoc section headers and build a nested heading hierarchy with proper parent-child relationships
parse_asciidoc_list_items: parse AsciiDoc list items with nested indentation levels into grouped list structures
parse_asciidoc_tables: parse AsciiDoc pipe-delimited tables bounded by |=== markers into a grid-based TableData structure
parse_asciidoc_images: parse AsciiDoc image macros with path, dimensions, and captions into ImageRef objects
